name: Mariela Renteria
office: Lynwood Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Mariela Renteria is a candidate for the Lynwood Unified School District Governing Board. She grew up in Lynwood and attended the district's schools. As a high school student, she served on the district's LCFF/LCAP committee and helped draft a revised mission statement. As part of the alumni association, she later helped coordinate a college conference for Lynwood students with other alumni.
